# Cadence

> Cadence is an ambient context layer for Claude Code. It reads the room — music, time of day, self-reported state, git activity — and injects that state into every prompt so the agent can respond like someone who actually knows what you're in the middle of.

Cadence is built by Cullum & Co (https://cullum.co). It is a Claude Code plugin, currently a macOS-only alpha, distributed via npm as `@cullumco/cadence`.

## What it does

- Gathers ambient signals: currently playing music, time of day, system uptime, prompt timing, and optional self-reported state (`/cadence:state`).
- Infers four cadence dials — pace, tone, posture, proactivity — and injects them into every prompt as advisory context.
- Gives the agent a reframe lens: read the prompt the way someone in that state meant it, without overriding the user's literal words.

## Who it's for

Developer-practitioners who use Claude Code seriously — engineers, writers, and makers who are in their tools all day and notice when something is thoughtful versus generic.

## Install

- `/plugin marketplace add cullumco/cadence`
- `/plugin install cadence@cadence`
